metadata.name: drone-v2
metadata.recipe: ensemble distillation with pitch shifts of up to 12 semitones
metadata.teacher: three supervised K10 models (seeds 13, 15, 42), probabilities averaged over nine pitch shifts
metadata.unlabeled_audio: FMA medium, 24,827 thirty-second clips, evaluation tracks excluded

config.optimizer: AdamW, learning rate 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, cosine schedule
